name: Nagatsuka Saki
source: The bespectacled and level-headed member of the team, who keeps Maho in check whenever the latter goes overboard with her enthusiasm. She also stops Maho and Takenaka from fighting as well. She works with her father in an okonomiyaki shop, and whenever they start to cook okonomiyaki, Saki becomes serious at it.
